name: World English Bible
description: The World English Bible is a Public Domain translation of the Holy Bible into modern English (edition without the Deuterocanon).
edition: World English Bible (eBible.org engwebp, file updated 2026-10-18)
attribution: World English Bible (WEB), public domain. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.

notes.omitted_verses: Versículos sem texto nesta tradução (omitidos por crítica textual) não são importados: ex. Lucas 17:36, Atos 8:37, Atos 15:34, Atos 24:7.
notes.romans_doxology: A doxologia aparece em Romanos 14:24-26, e Romanos 16 termina no versículo 24.
